patent_grounding.rationale: The cited patent passages support the modeled turbine, injector, supply reservoir/pipe, alternator and coupling, sensing/control, and optional collecting reservoir/pump return loop. The unsupported turbine-discharge port/interface/flow identified in revision 5 is absent in revision 6.

functional_completeness.rationale: The representative core energy-conversion and sensing/control functions are modeled. Optional collection and pump are retained; no unsupported turbine discharge connection is asserted. Omission of the no-break embodiment is disclosed as a warning.

flow_consistency.rationale: Each remaining interface references a declared port ID with compatible flow types and directionality: supply-to-injector, jet-to-turbine, shaft/coupling/alternator, electrical output, signals, and collection-to-pump / pump-to-supply. No turbine discharge connection remains.

claim_traceability.rationale: Model metadata, physical components, ports, flows, interfaces, requirements and behavior items have citations; claim-based ranges and bucket geometry are supported. Optional collection/pump elements cite the patent's express preferred embodiment.

interfaces.rationale: Revision 6 fixes the prior malformed qualified identifiers: i_pump_supply now uses exact declared IDs `water_out` and `return_in`, and each other interface also references exact port IDs rather than qualified subsystem.port strings. Endpoints correspond to declared ports on the paired components, and interface flow types/directions are compatible. The schema does not provide an explicit owner field on interface records, but the current endpoint assignments follow the established port_this/port_mate convention consistently.

textbook_application.rationale: Textbook guidance supports modeling physical subsystems, flows/interfaces, and traceability; it is used as modeling guidance rather than as evidence of patent facts.

summary: Independent review of saved revision 6: the earlier interface defects are corrected. The remaining interface records use exact declared port IDs and connect compatible endpoints; the inferred turbine-discharge connection has been removed, along with its unsupported port and flow. No actionable findings identified.
